meta_description: Located in north Chandler, ATL Wings has been a staple for Arizona wing fanatics since it's doors opened in 2012. ATL Wings is dubbed the "King of Wings" with its continuous reign as winner of Wingstock Arizona for 2013, 2014 and 2015. ATL Wings features a variety of handcrafted sauces including traditional mild and hot varieties you may come to expect, but they also offer some unique options including Honey Habenoro, Citrus Chipotle, Garlic Parmesan and Sweet 'n' Tangy. In addition to their award-winning wings, be sure to save room for their made from scratch Mac n' Cheese or Sweet Corn bites, homemade coleslaw, fresh salads and tempting desserts. Wash it all down with a fountain soda, or a variety of on-tap Kool Aid flavors and iced teas.

title: Auntie Anne's Pretzels
meta_description: Located at Chandler Fashion Center, Auntie Anne's features fresh, warm pretzels all made from scratch with many different flavors.

title: Avion Center
meta_description: The Avion Center provides a variety of rentable spaces that are well-equipped to host grand gatherings or intimate occasions. The Red Baron and Voyager Rooms are perfect for business functions while the main ballroom and patio area are well suited for larger events. Each space is outfitted with state of the art A/V equipment. Avion Center's highly trained, professional staff will assure that every detail of your event or gathering is expertly handled. Coffee service is available on-site and a prep kitchen is available for professional caters to use for events requiring food and beverage.

title: AZ Mucho Taco
meta_description: AZ Mucho Taco is a small, family owned Mexican restaurant featuring authentic Mexican food. With a name like AZ Mucho Taco, of course there will be a number of tacos on the menu including Carne Asada (steak), Al Pastor (marinated pork), and Camaron (shrimp) - but don't let that keep you from trying one of their soups, burritos or seafood delicacies and make sure to save room for a churro or traditional flan.

title: AZ Pho & Grill
meta_description: Find authentic Vietnamese cuisine at this family-friendly, locally owned restaurant. From traditional Pho noodle soup to tasty Banh Mi sandwiches, entrees and beverages - diners will enjoy a great selection of dishes.

title: AZ Pho & Grill
meta_description: AZ Pho Grill serves authentic, Vietnamese fare at their two Chandler restaurants. While the restaurants may be more well known for their traditional Pho noodle soups, the restaurants also feature a variety of rice dishes, vermicelli bowls, and Banh Mi - traditional Vietnamese sandwiches. Diners will also enjoy the large selection of refreshing beverages including boba milk teas, smoothies, fresh lemonade, and Vietnamese iced/hot coffee drinks.

title: Back Alley BBQ
meta_description: Back Alley BBQ serves bold flavors with its championship barbecue and a Chef-driven menu guided by Executive Chef, Shaun O'Neale and pit poss Ken Davis. O'Neale is known to many BBQ aficionados as the winner of Season 7 of Fox's MasterChef in 2016 and as the author of his cookbook, My Modern American Table. Diners will find a great selection of smoked meats, including brisket and ribs, and classic, homemade barbecue side dishes, such as creamed elote, mac and cheese, potato salad, and more. The BBQ restaurant offers a robust cocktail menu, a daily happy hour with drink specials, and live music on weekends.

title: Backyard Taco
meta_description: Originally from Mazatlan, Mexico - Ruben and Marisela Alvarez came to the east valley and began cooking out of their backyard. First it was just for friends and family but as the word grew they needed more space - everyone wanted a taste of their tacos al carbon. They opened their first location in Mesa, Arizona and have since opened five other locations across the east valley including one in Chandler, AZ. From the tacos and quesadillas to their signature papa loca and bueno bowls, you can top them with a variety of dips from their salsa bar. Don’t forget the unlimited chips and beans or the refreshing aguas frescas.

title: Ballet Arizona
meta_description: Experience the artistry and excitement of Arizona’s nationally recognized ballet company. Ballet Arizona, the Valley’s premiere professional ballet company, and their 2022-2023 season offers ballets that will inspire, entertain, and showcase the growing artistic excellence of Ib Andersen and the awe-inspiring Ballet Arizona dancers. With a blend of classics and new works, the 2022-2023 season is something you won’t want to miss! Tickets at balletaz.org or by calling the Ballet Arizona box office at: (602) 381-1096. title: Bark & Luv
meta_description: It's easy to treat your favorite furry friend at this Chandler pet boutique store featuring top quality cat and dog food, toys, treats, accessories and specialty gifts for pet lovers. This beautiful boutique also features a deluxe barkery and luxurious self-washing stations to spoil your pet

title: Barleens Dinner Show
meta_description: Family owned and operated, the Barleens Dinner Show features a variety of shows throughout the season that are filled with great music, singing, dinner and plenty of fun. Matinee options are available with doors opening at 11:15 AM and lunch served at noon, the doors open for the dinner show at 5:15 PM with dinner served at 6 PM. The facility is a great option for groups as well with group rates available for group of 22 or more.

title: Barro's Pizza
meta_description: Barro's Pizzza is a family-friendly restaurant that serves up a variety of delicious thick and thin crust pizzas along with wings, salads, pasta dishes and sandwiches. They also have gluten free options (Udi's® gluten-free crust).

title: Barro's Pizza
meta_description: Convenient, fast, and tasty thick slices of Chicago style pizza are synonymous at Barro's Pizza! Pizza served by the slice or in whole pies for dine in or take away. In addition to a large variety of fresh toppings, Barro's also offers a gluten-free pizza featuring Udi's® crust in a 10-inch style pizza. This location also serves a variety of deli-style sandwiches, pastas, salads, wings and offers daily lunch specials.

title: Barro's Pizza
meta_description: Barro's Pizzza is a family-friendly restaurant serving thick and thin crust pizzas along with wings, salads, pasta dishes and sandwiches. In addition to a salad bar, the restaurant also offers an optional Udi's® gluten-free crust.

title: Bawarchi Biryanis
meta_description: Located in south Chandler, Bawarchi Biryanis serves authentic Indian food including a great selection of appetizers, biryani and more.

title: Baymont by Wyndham Chandler I-10
meta_description: Baymont by Wyndham Chandler I-10 is conveniently located in West Chandler near the intersection of I-10 and the Loop 202 Santan. With 70 rooms boasting dozens of great amenities, this budget-friendly hotel is a great choice for those who want to balance practicality and comfort. Within a short drive from Downtown Chandler, the Tempe campus of Arizona State University, Wild Horse Pass Resort and Casino, Lone Butte Casino, and South Mountain Park, the largest municipal park in the US. Traveling for Business? This hotel is located near the corporate offices of Intel, Microchip, Tokyo Electron, Wells Fargo, Bank of America, Honeywell, and PayPal. Every room enjoys the benefits of a microwave, a refrigerator, and a coffee pot. This property is 100% smoke-free and offers free wifi Internet access throughout. Whether business or pleasure, this hotel is very conveniently located and very comfortable for both long- and short-term stays.

title: bb.q Chicken
meta_description: Originally founded in Korea in 1995, Bb.q Chicken is now open in Chandler! The recipes and ingredients are true to Korean tradition. Enjoy their diverse range of sauces and authentic Korean menu.

title: Bear Creek Golf Complex
meta_description: Chandler's Bear Creek Golf Complex is a 36-hole inland links golf facility consisting of both a championship course and an executive course. Both golf courses and practice area at Bear Creek Golf Complex were created by the Nicklaus Design Group and architect Bill O'Leary. In addition to our their golf courses they also have a full Practice and Learning Center,staffed by PGA Professionals who are available for both individual and group lessons. This family-friendly club also boasts the Bear's Den Bar & Grill includes a bar area with plenty of seating, comfortable shaded patio seating with beautiful views and three large flat screen televisions always tuned to sports.

title: Bear's Den Bar & Grill
meta_description: Located at the Bear Creek Golf Complex, the Bear's Den Bar & Grill offers breakfast and lunch form 7 a.m. - 3 p.m. and bar service available till 5:30 p.m. Traditional breakfast dishes are available till 11:30 a.m. great for fueling up for a day on the course or grabbing lunch and enjoying a drink, relaxing after your round of golf. Indoor seating is available, but Bear's Den Bar & Grill offers fantastic, sweeping views of the 18th hold of both courses from their covered patio.

title: Beijing Chinese
meta_description: Located in south Chandler, Beijing Chinese restaurant serves New York-style Chinese cuisine. The restaurant offers reasonably priced traditional Chinese favorites and offers a daily lunch special. Delivery is available within certain restrictions.

title: BelAfia
meta_description: BelAfia is a casual cafe serving a wide selection of boba drinks, artisanal ice cream & desserts, along with a large variety of sandwiches and snack foods with an Indian flair.

title: Bella Gusto Urban Pizzeria
meta_description: Bella Gusto Urban Pizzeria combines a traditional Neapolitan style pizzeria with a modern eatery for a new concept that highlights traditional cuisine and artisanal eats including fresh pasta dishes, hand crafted desserts and half-dozen panini sandwiches. The restaurant's bar features a large variety of Italian wines, local craft beers available by the bottle, as well as house-made sangria and limoncello.

title: Bella Rose Estate
meta_description: Bella Rose Estate is a two-acre private estate with lush landscaping featuring dramatic waterfalls, delightfully soothing water fountains, arches and gazebos for an amazing outdoor garden setting for your wedding, reception or special event in Chandler, AZ. In addition to the beautiful outdoor grounds, Bella Rose Estate also features a large indoor facility, the Grand Ballroom can accommodate seating and dance floor for 300 guests.

title: Benihana
meta_description: Exhibition-style, Japanese cuisine where the masterful chefs demonstrate their skills nightly on hibachi tables serving up a full-range of unique and traditional dishes that are prepared to order.

title: Besh-Ba-Gowah Archaeological Park
meta_description: Besh-Ba-Gowah Archaeological Park in Globe, Arizona features a 700 year old Salado Culture pueblo and typical furnishings of the era. Numerous artifacts of this remarkably advanced culture are also displayed in the Besh-Ba-Gowah Museum. Besh-Ba-Gowah has one of the largest single site archaeological collections in the southwest and is one of the most significant finds of Southwest archaeology. It is one of the largest and most complex of the Salado communities. Archaeologists consider Besh-Ba-Gowah a ceremonial, redistribution and food storage complex.

title: Best Pizza & Brew
meta_description: Located in Downtown Chandler, Best Pizza & Brew is a neighborhood pizzeria and taproom serving New York–style pizza made with fresh ingredients. The menu also features wings, burgers, sandwiches, salads, and desserts like butterscotch pudding. With a full bar, rotating craft beer, and indoor and outdoor seating, it’s a great spot for happy hour, dinner with friends, or a family night out.

title: Best Western Inn of Chandler
meta_description: This Southwest-inspired hotel boasts 48 rooms, a heated pool, a Jacuzzi hot tub and a complimentary continental breakfast daily. Each spacious and comfortable room has a coffee pot and a hair dryer for traveling convenience. This property is located within a mile of the Chandler Center for the Arts and the heart of Downtown Chandler which features boutique shops, galleries, and dozens of one-of-a-kind, locally owned restaurants, offering a unique and local flair you can only experience in Chandler. Within only a few miles drive, one can be to Arizona State University, South Mountain Park, the Phoenix Sky Harbor Airport, and a short drive to the Oakland A's, Los Angeles Angels of Anaheim and Chicago Cubs Spring Training ballparks.

title: Beverly Canyon Trailhead
meta_description: The Beverly Canyon Trail is along the south side of South Mountain Park and is a moderate, 1.7 mile hike that features some steep and rocky areas as it crosses the Pima Canyon area with an elevation change of 250 feet. The trail connects with other trails which makes it possible to extend your exploration.

title: Big Air Trampoline Park
meta_description: Big Air Trampoline Park is a premier family fun destination with ninja-warrior courses, interactive dodgeball courts, foam pits with plenty of excitement for the whole family. The 30,000 sq. ft. facility also features Battlebeam®, a zip-line, and ValoMotion - a new experience that tests speed, reaction, and hand-to-eye coordination. Climbers will enjoy unique climbing attractions: Challenge yourself to "The Wall" , a new attraction that is a stand alone climbing wall where you fall into a large foam pit if you miss a step. The park will also include Lil' Air and Lil' Ninja, an exclusive space for kids ages 6-and-under with trampolines, a foam pit and soft play elements. Parents and caretakers can relax in Big Air's Parents' Lounge, with access to comfortable seating, free WiFi, and food including pizza, wings, drinks and more from Big Eats Cafe.

title: Bikanervala
meta_description: Bikanervala is a renowned Indian sweets, snacks, and restaurant chain known for its authentic flavors and rich culinary heritage. Originating from India, Bikanervala serves traditional Indian street food and snacks; mithai (sweets), namkeen (savory snacks), and various North and South Indian dishes.

title: Birrieria Don Jose
meta_description: Birrieria Don Jose specializes in slow-roasted birria, a traditionally spicy and savory Mexican stew that’s slow cooked until the meat is tender. Stop by for a birria taco, quesadilla, torta, burro, or breakfast burrito.

title: Biryani Pot, Indian Restaurant
meta_description: Biryani Pot is a traditional Hyderabadi food house serving fresh authentic Hyderbadi Dum Biryani with their proprietary recipe at Biryani Pot. From traditional to more contemporary dishes, diners will savor genuine flavors and dishes of India.

title: Bisbee Breakfast Club
meta_description: Located in west Chandler, the Bisbee Breakfast Club is an established breakfast-and-lunch eatery known for its diner-style breakfast and lunch dishes, house-made pies and brunch-style cocktails. Open daily for breakfast and lunch.

title: BJ's Restaurant Brewhouse
meta_description: Find an extensive menu including award-winning deep-dish pizza, shareable appetizers, house made salads and more at this high-energy West Chandler restaurant. Adults will enjoy fine handcrafted beer and cocktails enjoyed in the large dining room, or expansive patio that seats 80. The Chandler restaurant also features several big screen TVs that are perfect for watching the game - just be sure to save room for the famous Pizookie, part cookie, part pizza!

title: Black Angus Steakhouse
meta_description: Black Angus Steakhouse is located near Chandler Fashion Center with easy access to Loop 101. Featuring a comfortable atmosphere, diners will enjoy fresh, hand-cut steaks that are grilled over an open flame capturing the one-of-a-kind campfire flavor that is their trademark. All steaks are Black Angus beef and aged a minimum of 21 days for maximum flavor and tenderness. The restaurant also features a number of gluten-free options and provides a large, gluten-free trail map to guide diners on a gluten-free meal. Happy hour is available Monday - Friday with all day Tuesdays & Sundays!

title: Black Bear Diner
meta_description: Located in south Chandler, Black Bear Diner is a family-friendly restaurant serving the comforts of home for breakfast, lunch and dinner. The restaurant is a popular gathering spot for breakfast diners.

title: Black Rock Coffee
meta_description: This chain coffee establishment features classic and specialty coffee beverages, snacks and small plates for light meals either through their drive-thru or counter service.

title: Blackberry Café
meta_description: Operated by a husband and wife team, the Blackberry Café is open daily for breakfast and lunch featuring a large selection of diner favorites. Breakfast items include a variety of omeletes, crepes, skillets, breakfast sandwiches, pancakes and waffles and lunch entrees include hot and cold sandwiches, hamburgers, wraps, soups and salads.

title: BlackSheep Wine Bar & Merchant
meta_description: BlackSheep Wine Bar and Merchant is an unequivocally equal parts wine bar and conversational destination. Visit this wine bar in historic Downtown Chandler and enjoy a glass of wine, great cocktails and delicious American bites on the patio or in their stylish dining room. From brunch, happy hours, and late night drinks, BlackSheep is the perfect place for any occasion.

title: Blue 32 Sports Grill
meta_description: Blue 32 Sports grill is a family owned sports grill located in south Chandler. The full service restaurants serves fresh ground hamburgers, steaks, sandwiches, salads and seafood in viewing range of their giant screen TVs to catch the latest sporting events.

title: Boba & Donuts
meta_description: Located in west Chandler - Boba & Donuts is a casual, family-owned restaurant serving freshly made donuts, bagels, coffee and blended/iced drinks along with a selection of Boba teas.

title: Boba and Brew Tea House
meta_description: Find a vast selection of milk teas, boba, fresh juices, and Vietnamese coffee at this casual local shop. Pair your drink with delicious Vietnamese appetizers and sandwiches.

title: Boba Tea House
meta_description: Discover the world of Bubble Tea - a phenomenon that originated in Southeast Asia on the island of Taiwan. The Boba Tea House located in north Chandler is home to a large menu of bubble teas - tapioca balls added to tea in addition to milk teas, milk juices, slush's, snow's and mocha blasts - your are sure to discover hundred of tempting drinks. Home to traditional flavors like almond, and more "exotic" gems such as lychee. Boba Tea House also offers a variety of tasty snacks including popcorn chicken, mozzarella sticks, fried calamari, fish balls and more traditional fried snack foods. Boba Tea House also offers free Wi-Fi for their guests.

title: Bonsai
meta_description: Located in south Chandler in Downtown Ocotillo, Bonsai features Japanese fusion inspired cuisine and finely crafted sushi rolls in a hip, modern, lounge-like setting while serving up a robust sake menu and engaging cocktails.

title: Born & Bred
meta_description: Born & Bred, located in downtown Chandler, Arizona, offers lunch, dinner and weekend brunch dining options. The restaurant's vibrant atmosphere blends contemporary style with artistic touches, including colorful murals and eclectic furnishings. Their menu showcases a mix of classic favorites and inventive dishes, all crafted with local ingredients and bold flavors.

title: Bosa Donuts
meta_description: A local legend, Bosa Donuts is a classic, no-frills donut shop - featuring the traditional, glazed donuts that are light & fluffy, try a delicious apple fritter, maple bar or even the glazed coconut. Of course, there are a variety of sprinkles to delight the wee ones in addition to breakfast and lunch sandwiches, smoothies and hot beverages. This is a must visit for all donut lovers!

title: Bosa Donuts
meta_description: Bosa Donuts Chandler is a local favorite for traditional, classic donuts that include a wide range of glazes, sprinkles and toppings that will please donut aficionados of all ages.

title: Bosa Donuts
meta_description: Whether you prefer a traditional glazed donut or the richness of a delicate apple fritter, Bosa Donuts Chandler has a large variety of donuts to satisfy your donut craving. Bosa Donuts also serves a variety of beverages including smoothies and a small selection of sandwiches.

title: Bottle & Bean
meta_description: Bottle & Bean is the newest community gathering spot in Downtown Ocotillo serving up coffee and wine alongside breakfast favorites and a lunch menu that boasts salads, bowls, and sandwiches. Customers are able to shop in a retail space and lounge outside with space for a picnic.

title: Bourbon Jim's
meta_description: Bourbon Jim’s is West Chandler’s newest neighborhood bar, bringing a lively blend of rock ’n’ roll, country, and classic bar‑hangout vibes to the southeast corner of Ray and Kyrene. This local spot offers more than 20 beers on tap, an impressive lineup of bourbons and tequilas, and a welcoming atmosphere perfect for kicking back with friends. Guests can catch live music every Friday, Saturday, and Sunday on Bourbon Jim’s state-of-the-art stage, making it a go‑to destination for weekend entertainment. Whether you’re stopping in for a cold beer, exploring their deep spirits selection, or settling in for a night of live bands, Bourbon Jim’s brings a fresh energy to the West Chandler dining and Chandler's nightlife scene.

title: Boutique on Boston
meta_description: Boutique on Boston, located in historic Downtown Chandler, Arizona is a women's fashion boutique offering classic and unique clothing and accessories. Chandler-based owner Denise McCreery personally selects each item, focusing on boutique-only designers and small-batch pieces to ensure exclusivity and that each piece is of high quality. The Chandler boutique store provides a personalized shopping experience, catering to women seeking distinctive, affordable fashion that reflects their style.

title: Bowlero Kyrene Bowl
meta_description: Looking for an exciting activity that everyone will enjoy - bowling, billiards, video games and plenty of beverages at the newly renovated Bowlero Kyrene!

title: Bowlero Kyrene Bowl
meta_description: Host your next team building event or get together at Bowlero Kyrene where the staff will make it easy to finalize plans and provide a fun outing for all. The facility offers customizable packages to create the perfect outing. Visitors will enjoy the 40 bowling lanes, arcade, cilliards/pool and on-site pro shop.

title: Boyce Thompson Arboretum
meta_description: Experience the lush beauty of the Arizona Upland Sonoran Desert at the state's oldest and largest botanical garden. With breathtaking views of Picketpost Mountain, Boyce Thompson Arboretum is located in Superior, Arizona, just an hour's drive from Downtown Chandler. The Arboretum features 343-acres of beautiful landscapes with over 3,900 different species of plants, hidden gardens along miles of trails, and historic buildings, the Arboretum is on the National Register of Historic Places. A haven for wildlife, the Arboretum has been called "the most enchanting" Important Birding Area in Arizona.

title: Brews Taphouse - A Burger Joint
meta_description: Brews Taphouse - A Burger Joint is family-owned and serves local craft beer and gourmet burgers. They have 24 rotating taps, a full-service bar, and a private outdoor patio.

title: Brews Taphouse - A Burger Joint
meta_description: This is the West Chandler location for Brews Taphouse, a family-friendly gastropub serving fresh, gourmet-style burgers and a bevy of local beers on tap.

title: Bricks & Minifigs Chandler
meta_description: Specializing in new and used LEGO, this Chandler toy store is a must-visit for LEGO fans. The store features a wide selection of unique, new, and gently used LEGO items, individual minifigs, bulk bricks, and accessories.

title: Brickyard Downtown
meta_description: The Brickyard Downtown is an upscale, contemporary concept located in a historic building located in Downtown Chandler. The dinner-only, New American menu has Spanish influences and specializes in tapas-style shareable plates and craft cocktails, The eatery features seasonal cocktails along with a dozen craft beers on tap.

title: Brooker's Founding Flavors Ice Cream
meta_description: Step into Chandler’s newest ice cream tavern, celebrating Revolutionary‑era America with super‑premium, in‑house churned ice cream, drinking chocolate, and unforgettable atmosphere. Colonial music, décor, and costumed staff give this spot a theme park‑style dining vibe infused with early American history. Discover revolution‑themed treats: sundaes, banana splits, milkshakes, ice cream cakes, and the iconic Founding Flavors, 13 colony‑inspired flavors like John Hancock’s Mint Chocolate Truffle, Thomas Jefferson’s Declaration of Cookie Dough, Franklin’s Black Raspberry Republic, and Martha Washington’s Colonial Cotton Candy 31. The cafe also serves a selection of drinking chocolate: thick, rich, and historically authentic, and reminiscent of what the Founding Fathers enjoyed. Located near Chandler Fashion Center mall and many of Chandler's top family attractions, the ice cream shop is a great addition to your itinerary! The ice cream shop is open Monday through Saturday from 11 a.m. - 11 p.m. and on Sundays from 11 a.m. - 10 p.m.

title: Brooklyn V's Pizza
meta_description: Originally from Brooklyn, NY - Vito LoPiccolo owned and operated restaurants in New York for 20 years before moving to Arizona. The family owned and operated restaurant uses fresh ingredients and makes their dough and pizza sauce from scratch for their pizzas, calzones and strombolis. Diners will find a selection of salads, sandwiches, pastas and desserts on the menu.

title: Brooklyn V's Pizza
meta_description: Located in south Chandler, the family-owned pizzeria is like having a bit of Brooklyn, New York in Arizona! Find New York-style pizza, pasta, calzones and more.

title: Bruster's Real Ice Cream of Chandler
meta_description: Bruster’s features 150 flavors of handcrafted ice cream, yogurt, Italian ice & sorbet in their repertoire. The Arizona ice cream store offers a minimum of at least 24 handcrafted options daily that may be enjoyed in fresh waffle cones or their signature desserts.

title: Buffalo Wild Wings
meta_description: Buffalo Wild Wings is located at Chandler Fashion Center mall and is a lively sports-bar serving traditional sports bar fare including a wide range of wings, cold drinks and large-screen TVs focused on sports.

title: Burrito Express
meta_description: Burrito Express is a family owned and operated, counter-service restaurant featuring traditional Mexican food in a casual atmosphere. In addition to a number of breakfast burritos, the restaurant also offers limited delivery service.

title: Burst of Butterflies Pottery Painting & Art Studio
meta_description: Located in Downtown Chandler, Burst of Butterflies is a welcoming paint-your-own pottery and creative studio designed for all ages and experience levels. Guests can walk in anytime to paint pottery or canvas, or reserve a seat in one of their guided classes, including canvas painting and clay hand-building or pottery wheel experiences. No experience is needed — their friendly team is there to help every step of the way. Burst of Butterflies is known for its relaxed, creative atmosphere where individuals, families, and groups can slow down, connect, and create something meaningful to take home. Popular at the Studio Walk-in pottery painting and canvas painting Clay wheel-throwing and clay hand-building classes Guided canvas classes Date nights & girls’ nights Birthday parties & group celebrations Team building events Kids and family experiences Whether you’re planning a fun outing or trying something new, Burst of Butterflies offers a memorable, hands-on experience in the heart of Downtown Chandler.

title: Butterfly Wonderland
meta_description: This delightful indoor and interactive rainforest habitat features thousands of butterflies for a one-of-a-kind experience for visitors of all ages. In addition to the butterfly exhibits, a Butterflies 3D Movie rounds out the experience.

title: Cactus Flower Florists
meta_description: Award-winning Cactus Flower Florists is an established flower shop serving Arizona since 1972. Offering a diverse selection of fresh flowers, plants, gift baskets, and more for weddings, special occasions, and holidays. Whether you opt to pick up the flowers or have them delivered, you will find great arrangements and more at this store. The Chandler location is open Mondays through Thursdays from 10 a.m. - 4 p.m., Fridays from 10 a.m. - 5 p.m. and on Saturdays from 10 a.m. - 2 p.m. The Chandler flower shop is closed on Sundays.

title: Café 86
meta_description: Enjoy a selection of milk teas, slushes, Filipino tea, coffee, light snacks and desserts at Café 86. The Chandler cafe is the famed restaurant's first to Arizona location and is located in north Chandler.

title: Cafe Rio Mexican Grill
meta_description: Cafe Rio is synonymous with fresh, featuring made-from-scratch meals finely crafted by their amazing staff who diligently hand-craft all the components for each dish. From hand squeezing 1,000 limes to hand scooping avocados to grating the cheese to crafting each and every sauce and dressing - everything is made on-site, daily. Of course, this is in addition to the hundreds of hand-rolled tortillas cooked up on the coal, right in front of your very eyes! This family-friendly Tex-Mex restaurant is sure to please.

title: Cafe Zupas Chandler Fashion Center
meta_description: Cafe Zupas is well known for their exceptional, award-winning soups, salads, sandwiches and desserts that are hand crafted each and every day. The Chandler Fashion Center restaurant serves lunch and dinner and offers catering, six days a week.

title: Caffin8
meta_description: Located in the Workpliciti building in South Chandler, Caffin8 is a family-owned and operated cafe, serving coffee, breakfast, and lunch sandwiches to help you get through your workday! Swing by to get your fill of unique coffee blends, Red Bull smoothies, or energizer teas!

title: Calitacos Restaurant
meta_description: Calitacos Restaurant serves traditional street-style tacos in a family-friendly orientated dining space. The restaurant has a full bar and TVs to watch any game you may want. Along with tacos, the menu offers tortas, burritos, rolled tacos, birria tacos, and more!

title: Cambria Hotel Phoenix Chandler Fashion Center

meta_description: Experience upscale comfort and modern convenience at the Cambria Hotel Phoenix Chandler – Fashion Center. title: Candeeland
meta_description: Candeeland is a new Family Entertainment Center for the modern era. Truly the ultimate indoor playground- our park is bright, colorful, CLEAN, and filled with fun! With an emphasis on movement and inspiring creativity, we provide an engaging experience that gives children and toddlers the opportunity to explore, make friends, burn off energy, and have fun. Toddlers can play in a designated age-appropriate fun space, while kids ages 4-10 can crawl, jump, and slide in an interactive space all their own. Meanwhile, parents can relax, catch up on tasks, or even have a coffee or meal while their little ones play, secure in knowing their kids are having a blast in our state-of-the-art facilities. Our friendly and engaged staff members ensure that every child has a fantastic, safe experience that will leave them smiling ear to ear and excited to come back again and again.

title: Can't Stop Smokin' BBQ

Utilizing a 2,500-foot-ling path, navigate your way around the lake along a series of monuments and signs representing the sun, planets and primary celestial objects - all placed at distances relative to the scale of the solar system. Each foot on the walk represents 1.5 million miles which means that the distance from the sun to Earth is 62 feet along the walk — equivalent to the actual 93 million miles between the two in space. The signs provide detailed information about the planets and references to ancient cultures who studied the skies, mythology, the asteroid belt, dwarf planets, and comets. The self guided tour is perfect for budding astronomers!

Outdoor enthusiasts can explore nearby Desert Breeze Park, enjoy hiking at South Mountain Park and Preserve, or tee off at local favorites including Ocotillo Golf Club and San Marcos Golf Course. title: Crowne Plaza Phoenix-Chandler Golf Resort
meta_description: Some places become legendary. Some always have been! For Arizona, it all started in 1912 when the San Marcos celebrated it's grand opening and became Arizona's first and finest golf resort and a welcome respite for U.S. Presidents, dignitaries, Hollywood’s famous and infamous, and discriminating travelers for decades. Today, the Crowne Plaza Phoenix Chandler Golf Resort anchors Downtown Chandler, a vibrant and historic square brimming with more than two dozen independent restaurants, boutique shops, entertainment and home to many annual events. In addition, the sprawling property features 249 generously sized guest rooms and more than 30,000 square feet of flexible meeting and event space. With on-site dining, resort-style pool with cabanas and Arizona's first grass golf course, the Crowne Plaza Phoenix Chandler Golf Resort is an excellent option for many travelers.

title: Desert Belle Cruises
meta_description: Originally launched in 1964, the Desert Belle has been plowing the waters of Saguaro Lake for over forty years. Private cruises are also available for an unforgettable wedding, birthday, anniversary or office party. The Desert Belle is a unique way to enjoy all the beauty that Arizona has to offer.

title: Desert Botanical Garden
meta_description: Nestled amid the red buttes of Papago Park, the Desert Botanical Garden hosts one of the world’s finest collections of desert plants. One of only 44 botanical gardens accredited by the American Association of Museums, this one-of-a-kind museum showcases 50 acres of beautiful outdoor exhibits. Home to 139 rare, threatened and endangered plant species from around the world, the Garden offers interesting and inspiring experiences to more than 300,000 visitors each year.

title: Desert Breeze Park and Spray Pad
meta_description: Desert Breeze Park is one of Chandler’s most cherished outdoor escapes, blending scenic beauty, family fun, and plenty of room to play. Centered around a picturesque lake and surrounded by vibrant green space, this 47‑acre park offers the perfect backdrop for a relaxing afternoon or an activity‑filled outing. Families especially love the Desert Breeze Railroad, a charming miniature train that loops through the park and delights riders of all ages. Just steps away, kids can cool off at the splash pad, explore multiple playgrounds, and enjoy hands‑on fun at the interactive spray features. Shaded ramadas and spacious picnic areas make it easy to settle in for birthday parties, weekend picnics, or casual gatherings with friends. Active visitors will find plenty of ways to stay moving, from lighted tennis courts and sand volleyball to baseball fields and open green space perfect for informal games. The park’s paved walking paths offer a scenic route for joggers, strollers, and dog walkers, while the lake provides a peaceful setting for a leisurely stroll. Whether you’re hopping aboard the miniature train, planning a family celebration, or simply soaking up Chandler’s sunny weather, Desert Breeze Park delivers a refreshing, family‑friendly retreat in the heart of the city. title: Desert Voyagers Guided Rafting Tours
meta_description: Our scenic guided river tours are a perfect introduction to the beauty and wonder of the Sonoran Desert. Bring the whole family along on a mild rafting trip, pilot your own craft on a fun and exhilarating guided kayak adventure, or learn a new skill with a fun and challenging stand up paddle board tour. All of Desert Voyagers trips are designed to emphasize the unique beauty of the surrounding desert and the plants and animals who call this area home. You guides will introduce you to the mighty saguaro cactus, explain just how a beaver builds its home, and illuminate the rich human and natural history of the Salt River, all while teaching you the skills to be a confident paddler. Each tour can be made suitable for beginners, rafting float trips are suitable for all ages and ability levels. Our tours are offered on the Salt and Verde Rivers in the Tonto National Forest, 30 minutes east of the Mesa area. Groups and individuals welcome. Average trip is about two hours on the water. Snacks, water, equipment and professional safety certified guides are included. Hotel pick-up is available.

meta_description: Experience Arizona Flavors at d’Vine Gourmet Discover d’Vine Gourmet, a charming Arizona‑made gift shop located in the heart of Downtown Chandler — a walkable district filled with boutique shopping, public art, and locally loved dining spots. Known for its handcrafted wine jellies, gourmet snacks, artisan foods and curated gift baskets, d’Vine Gourmet has grown into a community hub that celebrates Arizona flavors and craftsmanship. meta_description: Elliott's Steakhouse, offers an upscale fine-dining experience specializing in premium steaks and seafood. title: Hot Air Expeditions
meta_description: Breathtaking. Magical. Awe-inspiring. These are just a few words that have been used to describe Hot Air Expeditions' ballooning experiences. Your journey begins with the viewing of the inflation of the balloon, where you will get a glimpse of how large the balloons are as they come to life! From there, your pilot whisks you away in the basket for your approximate one hour flight. During the journey, you will enjoy floating at different elevations, from up to 5,000 feet in the air for a gorgeous overview of the Sonoran Desert, to within feet of the desert floor, to catch a glimpse of local wildlife, plant life and landmarks. It is common to see jackrabbits, quail, coyote and even javelina. Upon landing, you'll toast to the adventure that ensued with flutes of chilled champagne and gourmet cuisine from the award-winning Vincent's on Camelback, complete with tables, linens and china - truly, a toast to the perfect day. You're sent back to reality with a memento of your time in the sky, a commemorative flight certificate, to take home. Morning flights available daily, year-round, and sunset flights are available November-March. Roundtrip hotel transfers available // FAA Certified // Insured. "Best Balloon Flight in Phoenix" - Fodor's Travel. Seen on ESPN, Fox 10, Channel 12 & more.

meta_description: Rated 4½ STARS by Golf Digest's "Best Places to Play" this 27-hole championship course offers a unique departure from the standard desert golf courses one might expect in Arizona. The Ocotillo Golf Club offers an upscale course that is perfect for tournament groups and corporate outings. The facility also features event space for groups of 5 to 250 that offer a unique setting for social and corporate gatherings. Whether you are looking for a small, intimate gather spot in their Director's Room, the large and spacious Crown Terrace Ballroom or the attractive Waterfall Patio, or the full-service restaurant, Ocotillo Golf Club offers well-equipped and special event spaces for your Chandler, AZ event.

title: OdySea Aquarium
meta_description: OdySea Aquarium is Arizona's largest and newest aquarium featuring more than 2,000,000 US gallons of water and over 30,000 animals for viewing. The aquarium is open 7 days a week, 365 days a year. Tickets may be purchased through the website or directly at the aquarium.

title: Old Chicago Pizza & Taproom
meta_description: Old Chicago Pizza & Taproom offers a diverse menu featuring handcrafted pizzas with customizable crusts—Chicago Thick, Tavern Thin, or Ale Crust infused with brown ale—alongside hearty pastas, burgers, and taproom starters like Sicilian Pepperoni Rolls and Italian Nachos. Guests can also enjoy rotating seasonal specials, such as the Nashville Hot Crispy Chicken Pizza and Music City Hot Mac, all complemented by an extensive selection of craft beers on tap.

title: Ollie the Trolley & Dunn Transportation
meta_description: Travel via trolley or by motor coach for your next corporate outing or city tour. Ollie the Trolley & Dunn Transportation will personally craft a transportation solution for your needs while paying attention to the details. Enclosed trolleys accommodate up to 30 passengers on cushioned, bench seats. Each vehicle is equipped with air-conditioning/heating, PA system with microphone and a CD player.

title: Oregano's Pizza Bistro
meta_description: Oregano's Pizza Bistro is known for their family-friendly, Chicago-style pizzas, pastas and salads all served in a lively atmosphere.

title: Organ Stop Pizza
meta_description: In 1972, the original Organ Stop Pizza restaurant premiered in Phoenix with a Wurlitzer pipe organ which was originally built for Grauman's Hollywood Egyptian Theater. This unique concept of a pizza parlor with a pipe organ was a phenomenal success and since its conception several more locations have opened around the country.

title: Original ChopShop Co.
meta_description: Located in Downtown Chandler, Original ChopShop Co. is known for their healthy salads, sandwiches and protein bowls. Early morning diners will enjoy their fresh-pressed juices, acai bowls and protein shakes and smoothies. The restaurant also caters to a variety of dietary needs and offers a number of options for gluten-free, vegan, vegetarian, peanut-free, lactose-free, and soy-free dining.

title: Orpheum Theatre
meta_description: After 12 years and $14 million the historic Orpheum Theatre has been renovated. Now a modern theater with the 1,364 seat Lewis Auditorium, The Orpheum Theatre complements the larger nearby U.S. Airways Arena, Dodge Theatre and Symphony Hall, as well as the smaller stages of the Herberger Theater Center.

title: Oscar's Taco Shop
meta_description: Oscar's Taco Shop is a casual, family-owned setting serving fresh Mexican cuisine, including their popular Surf & Turf Nachos, breakfast burritos, and an extensive tacos menu. With fresh ingredients prepared daily, the Chandler taco shop offers quick meals for those on the go.

title: Outback Steakhouse
meta_description: Outback Steakhouse is an Australian steakhouse restaurant. Although beef and steak items make up a good portion of the menu, the concept offers a variety of chicken, ribs, seafood, and pasta dishes.

title: OUTTA BRONX
meta_description: OUTTA BRONX serves delicious sandwiches, pizza, and wings.

title: Over Easy
meta_description: Locally owned and operated, Over Easy is a breakfast and brunch favorite with a large selection of made from scratch, traditional eats with a twist.

title: Over Easy
meta_description: Over Easy is a popular breakfast and brunch restaurant known for its modern twists on classic dishes like Banana Nut French Toast and Waffle Dogs. The restaurant offers a casual and inviting atmosphere, featuring a main dining room, bar, and patio. Over Easy has become a local favorite for its made-from-scratch meals and friendly service.

title: P.F. Chang's China Bistro
meta_description: Upscale restaurant with contemporary décor featuring traditional Chinese entrees and southeastern Asian inspired dishes.

title: Pacific Seafood Buffet
meta_description: All the seafood you want for one price. Sushi, crab, shrimp, scallops and more.

title: Padeland
meta_description: Get in the game at this one-of-a-kind indoor sports and social entertainment attraction in Downtown Chandler. Whether you're looking for a great place for a padel or pickleball match, grabbing a bite, a fun team-building activity, or unwinding over drinks, Padeland brings sports, connection, and memorable experiences together under one roof. Top Experiences at Padeland: Premier padel & pickleball courts Lomas restaurant & bar Craft brewery on-site Wellness area Pro shop Court reservations are required to play. Rates are available in the Padeland Chandler app for non-member open play and all-access memberships. Play, Gather, and Enjoy Padeland’s modern courts, welcoming atmosphere, and player-focused amenities make it an ideal spot for beginners and seasoned athletes alike. Whether you’re dropping in for open play, booking a court with friends, or participating in one of Padeland’s skill‑building clinics, you’ll find a friendly environment that encourages active fun. The facility’s thoughtful design offers opportunities to relax between games and connect with Chandler’s vibrant recreation community. Make a day of your visit by taking advantage of Downtown Chandler’s convenient parking options. Explore where to park at: https://www.VisitChandler.com/parking. After your match, enjoy a meal or drink in Downtown Chandler, which boasts a lively dining scene with everything from casual bites to chef‑driven restaurants. Learn more about dining at: https://www.VisitChandler.com/dining/downtown-chandler. Looking to round out your adventure with more recreation experiences? Chandler offers beautiful parks, trails for exploring, and scenic recreation areas perfect for continuing your active day. Discover additional outdoor recreation opportunities at: https://www.VisitChandler.com/outdoor-recreation. Whether you’re trying padel for the first time or seeking some fun entertainment on your Chandler getaway, Padeland adds an exciting, energetic chapter to Downtown Chandler’s entertainment offerings.

title: Palette Collective at Chandler Village
meta_description: Centrally located, Palette Collective offers creative studio coworking spaces for various retail industries including hair, beauty, food and beverage. Free onsite parking is available.

title: Palette Collective Coffee Bar & Co-Retail - Chandler Village
meta_description: Located near Chandler Fashion Center mall, the Chandler Village location of Palette Collective's Coffee Bar offers specialty shops and salons and full service coffeehouse. From espresso-based drinks, tea lattes, a selection of gourmet toasts and more - the modern café is a bright spot to any day.

title: Palette Collective Coffee Bar & Co-Retail
meta_description: One of two Palette Collective coffee bars in Chandler, diners will enjoy the entrepreneurial environment at this full service, local organic café offering espresso-based beverages, light snacks, tea lattes and more.

title: Papago Park
meta_description: Located minutes from Chandler near The Phoenix Zoo and Desert Botanical Garden, The trails in Papago Park are typically very smooth with minimal elevation gain, providing fast and easy access for hiking , walking and running. The park itself is split into east and west sides by Galvin Parkway. On the west side is the 2.3 mile Double Butte loop and on the east-side there is an interpretive trail highlight local flora and fauna along with a short hike to the famous picture op, Hole-in-the-Rock. Generally speaking, gated roadways are open sunrise to sunset, but the trails are open till 11 p.m.

title: Paradise Biryani Pointe
meta_description: Paradise Biryani Pointe is a successful Indian chain with 40 restaurants in more than 15 states. Entrees run the range and feature everything from vegetarian and chicken—such as Andhra Chicken Curry to Indo-Chinese options, plenty of appetizers to choose from, and family packs that serve up to five people

title: Paradise Kitchen
meta_description: Paradise Kitchen is located at the southwest corner of Alma School and Ray Roads in north Chandler. The family run eatery specializes in traditional Thai and Vietnamese dishes including curries, stir-fired noodles and Vietnamese crispy fried egg noodle entrees.

title: Paris Baquette
meta_description: Paris Baguette is a bakery café that blends French-inspired baking with Asian flavors, creating a warm, neighborhood-style experience. Located near Chandler Fashion Center mall, the cafe serves up freshly baked breads, croissants, pastries, cakes, specialty coffees, and teas in a cozy and inviting atmosphere. Visitors can find sandwiches, salads, and more for a light meal, as well as a grab-and-go market for a quick bite.

title: Park of the Canals
meta_description: Mesa’s Park of the Canal is one of Mesa’s premier public parks. It features a playground, reservable and non-reservable armadas and a desert botanical garden.

title: Paseo Trail
meta_description: The Paseo Trail is one of Chandler’s most popular outdoor pathways, offering 6.5 miles of scenic recreation along the eastern edge of the Consolidated Canal. With a smooth, 10‑foot‑wide concrete path on the east side and an unimproved dirt trail on the west, this versatile route welcomes walkers, joggers, bicyclists, stroller‑pushers, and even horseback riders. The trail has been a community favorite since its first phase opened in 2001, providing a peaceful, car‑free corridor through east Chandler. Several major road crossings feature lighted signals—including pedestrian and horseback‑height activation buttons—making it easy and safe to continue your journey. Visitors arriving by car will find convenient parking and restrooms at two key access points: • Tibshraeny Family Park (270 N. Cottonwood St.) – the northern trailhead, located just north of Chandler Blvd. and east of Cooper Rd. • Tumbleweed Park (2250 S. McQueen Rd.) – accessible from the east side of the park via the Los Arboles connection, south of Germann Rd. Whether you’re out for a morning run, a family bike ride, or a leisurely stroll with your dog, the Paseo Trail offers a refreshing way to enjoy Chandler’s sunshine and open spaces.

title: Paseo Vista Recreation Area & Dog Park
meta_description: Paseo Vista Recreation Area offers one of Chandler’s most unique outdoor experiences, transforming a former landfill into a scenic, elevated recreation space with sweeping 360-degree views of the East Valley. Most of the park’s amenities sit atop the hill—hidden from street level—so those who make the worthwhile walk, ride, or drive to the top are rewarded with a one‑of‑a‑kind setting to explore. This 64‑acre recreation area features an impressive mix of activities, including an archery range, a disc golf course, a playground, a dog park, and walking trails that wind through terraced landscapes. The elevated vantage point makes it a great spot for sunrise strolls, afternoon playtime, or simply taking in the panoramic desert scenery. Dog owners especially love the park’s spacious dog park, complete with unique training obstacles purchased through a Police Department grant. Pups can test their skills on a see‑saw, balance beam, tunnel, hurdles, and a large A‑frame, while humans enjoy shaded benches, doggy drinking fountains, and convenient waste‑bag stations. The entire area is enclosed by 6‑foot‑high fencing with a single main entrance to keep dogs safely contained. Getting here is easy: vehicle access is off McQueen Road, just ¼ mile north of Ocotillo Road, with more than 330 parking spaces available. The park also connects directly to the Paseo Trail along the Consolidated Canal, offering a seamless route for bicyclists, joggers, and walkers. Whether you’re practicing your aim, exploring the trails, enjoying time with your dog, or soaking up the views, Paseo Vista Recreation Area delivers a refreshing and unexpected outdoor escape in South Chandler. Open for public use from 6 a.m. to 10:30 p.m.

title: Pastries ’N’ Chaat
meta_description: Find savory and sweet pastries, chaat, and other Indian delicacies at this neighborhood bakery and restaurant.

title: Patent 139 Brewing Company
meta_description: Find craft brews with unique and bold flavors made by a Master Brewer at Patent 139 Brewing Company. Try innovative brews and dine on a great selection of food on a spacious patio that overlooks a lake.

title: Pedal Haus Brewery
meta_description: Locally owned and operated, this award-winning brewpub features a range of upscale fare that pairs with the house-crafted brews. The Downtown Chandler location offers a diverse array of entrees from a protein bowl to more traditional bar classics like burgers with a twist. Perfect for enjoying Arizona's great weather, the Pedal Haus Brewery features a large, dog-friendly patio that includes games, misters and televisions perfect for catching a sporting event.

title: Pei Wei Asian Diner
meta_description: Pei Wei offers bold flavors and fresh ingredients with a fun, casual diner environment. The restaurant features a variety of Asian dishes incorporating flavors from China, Japan, Korea, Thailand and Vietnam and offers several gluten-free dishes.

title: Peixoto Coffee
meta_description: Situated in Downtown Chandler, Peixoto Coffee features a unique, crop-to-cup experience that celebrates over a 100 years of Brazilian family tradition in a warm and modern setting. Pronounced ‘pay-SHOW-toe', the coffee that is roasted comes from beans harvested on the family farm, Fazenda Sao José da Boa Vista located in the Alta Mogiana region of Brazil. The green coffee beans are then roasted in small batches, on-site, front and center in their coffee lounge

title: Pei Wei Asian Diner
meta_description: Located at The Shoppes at Casa Paloma, Pei Wei offers bold flavors and fresh ingredients with a fun, casual diner environment. The restaurant features a variety of Asian dishes incorporating flavors from China, Japan, Korea, Thailand and Vietnam and offers a number of gluten-free dishes.

title: Perfect Pear Bistro
meta_description: Located just east of the Loop 101 on Chandler Blvd., the Perfect Pear Bistro offers a fresh take on modern, American-style comfort food. Find a selection of pastas, Panini sandwiches, fresh salads and an extended happy hour from 11 a.m. - 6 p.m.

title: Pesto's Italian Kitchen and Wine Bar
meta_description: Pesto's Italian Ktchen & Wine Bar is a long established Chandler restaurants known throughout the community for its authentic Italian cuisine. The chic yet casual eatery features more than 50 wines including six different wine flights, are offered with a great selection of entrees, appetizers and pizzas.

title: Petersen House Museum
meta_description: Built in the 1890s, today the Petersen House is a museum operated as an outreach of the Tempe History Museum. Tours are given of the house, focusing on lifestyles in Tempe during the territorial and depression eras.

title: Philly's Famous Cheese Steaks
meta_description: Counter-style service at this family-owned and operated eatery bringing traditional Philly cheesesteaks to Arizona. The restaurants also offers a selection of cold-cut sandwiches and sides.

title: Pho Chandler
meta_description: Located in south Chandler, this family owned restaurant serves traditional Vietnamese cuisine made fresh to order. Be sure to try the lemon grass chicken!

title: Pho Cyclo
meta_description: An Arizona pioneer for Vietnamese food in the metropolitan Phoenix area, Cyclo has been serving traditional Vietnamese dishes in a comfortably bright and modern setting.

title: Pho Dam
meta_description: Located in the Lee Lee Market, this hot spot for pho offers great variety at affordable prices and ample portions. In addition to pho, the restaurant offers a variety of spring rolls, a beef stew, meat plates, Vietnamese Iced Coffees, Milk Tea with boba and smoothies.

title: Pho Gia Dinh
meta_description: Located in Uptown Chandler, this casual, local spot offers authentic Vietnamese cuisine. Expect a variety of classic pho noodle offerings on the menu.

title: Pho Mai
meta_description: A local favorite for Vietnamese Pho - this local eatery is known for their large selection of tasty Vietnamese dishes, but the Pho is a specialty with the right mix of sweet and savory.

title: Phoenix Art Museum
meta_description: In 1996, the Phoenix Art Museum celebrated the conclusion of an extensive $25 million expansion and renovation which made it one of the largest general visual arts institutions in the Southwest. Their Collection of over 17,000 works spans the centuries and emphasizes American Art, Asian Art, and European Art of the 14th – 19th Centuries, Western American Art, Modern and Contemporary Art, Spanish Colonial and Latin American Art, 18th – 20th Century Fashion Design and the Thorne Miniature Rooms.

title: Phoenix Mercury Basketball (WNBA)
meta_description: The Phoenix Mercury is a member of the Women's National Basketball Association, playing in the Western Conference. The games are held at the Talking Stick Resort Arena in downtown Phoenix, May through August.

title: Phoenix Palace Buffet
meta_description: Noted as one of the best spots for dim sum in the Phoenix metro area, Phoenix Palace is a staple for authentic Cantonese cuisine. Located in the heart of Chandler, it is famous for its traditional push-cart dim sum service offered daily, 10 a.m. - 3 p.m. The restaurant also features an extensive seafood menu.

title: Phoenix Police Museum
meta_description: In October 1993, the Phoenix Police Museum started as a small exhibit at the Historic City Hall. After the Arizona Humanities Council determined that there were enough artifacts to start a permanent museum, Barrister Place transformed into the Phoenix Police Museum. Exhibits include a mock up of a 1910 city street and an old jail cell.

title: Phoenix Premium Outlets
meta_description: Conveniently located at Exit 162 off of Interstate 10, Phoenix Premium Outlets is an upscale collection of 90 outlet stores offering name brand savings at designer stores including Coach, DKNY, Michael Kors, Kate Spade New York, Saks Fifth Avenue OFF 5th and many others.

title: Phoenix Raceway
meta_description: Phoenix Raceway has a tradition that is unmatched in the world of racing. The Indycars have made 58 visits to Phoenix Raceway and the annual NASCAR weekends held each March and November -- including NASCAR NEXTEL Cup, Busch, Craftsman Trucks and Featherlite Southwest Series races -- is one of the biggest events in the entire state. As a matter of fact, the Checker Auto Parts 500 NASCAR Winston Cup Series race is arguably the largest one-day sporting event in Arizona.

title: Phoenix Rising FC
meta_description: A member of the United Soccer League, the Phoenix Rising Football Club is a professional men's soccer team that was founded in 2014. Part of the Western conference, regular season games are generally held March through October.

title: Phoenix Sky Harbor International Airport (PHX)
meta_description: Visitors utilizing commercial airline service to the Chandler area will arrive via Phoenix Sky Harbor International Airport, located about 20 minutes from Chandler along Interstate-10. Long recognized by passenger vote as "America's Friendliest Airport" the airport provides air services to approximately 1,200 daily arrivals and departures. The airport features a number of amenities including free Wi-Fi, a large selection of restaurants that are uniquely Arizonan, art exhibits, boutique shops and pet parks for traveling pets.

title: Phoenix Suns Basketball
meta_description: The Phoenix Suns are a member of the National Basketball Association's Western Conference and a member of the Pacific Division. The NBA's Phoenix Suns take the court at Talking Stick Resort Arena in downtown Phoenix, November thru April. Join the locals and cheer for the Phoenix Suns dressed in team colors: orange, purple, gray, white and black.

title: Phoenix Symphony
meta_description: Founded in 1947, The Phoenix Symphony serves more than 300,000 people annually, with 275 concerts and presentations throughout the Valley of the Sun and beyond. The 75-member Phoenix Symphony presents an annual season from September through May, featuring classical and pops concerts in downtown Phoenix, along with a variety of symphonic and community presentations in Scottsdale, in Prescott, and throughout central Arizona.

title: Pickleball Kingdom
meta_description: Come experience Chandler's largest indoor pickleball facility at Pickleball Kingdom in West Chandler. Featuring 15 courts, this venue offers daily drop-in play, expert lessons, Pro shop, tournaments and more. Unique to the facility is a great upper mezzanine viewing area complete with Sports TV which makes it a perfect option for corporate events to family reunions.

title: Pie Snob
meta_description: Piesnob, which has a few locations in the valley, is well known for their Pie Vending Machine. Each week they offer a variety of pie flavors in store. With several different flavors and varieties, the options are endless. Whole pies and slices are available first come, first serve-- but you can always preorder your pies!

title: PIEfection
meta_description: Arizona-based PIEfection has been in the valley since 2012 and has been named the #1 pie shop in Arizona by many organizations, including: Yahoo.com, MSN.com and Travel.com. The Chandler dessert shop features a wide selection of more than 70 dessert pies and savory pies including quiche and pot pies. Everything is made from scratch at this French patisserie-style bakery where you will find whole pies as pleasing to the eye as the palate. Their company mission is to “Help families and friends create memories together, around the table with amazing food!” Pie lovers will not be disappointed in any one of their varieties, including this summer seasonal favorite, Summer Berry Cheesecake. Summer local favorites include unique dessert pies like Arizona Orange made from locally grown sour oranges or other favorites including Lime in the Coconut, Boston Cream with Raspberry Filling, or a Turtle Cheesecake made with authentic homemade caramel, a feat most bakers won’t even try!

title: Pioneer Arizona Living History Museum
meta_description: See the Opera House where Lilly Langtry sang, look through a rifle port in the actual cabin that survived Arizona's bloodiest range war, or browse through an 1890's dress shop. All of this, plus a blacksmith shop, sheriff's office and jail, complete ranch complex and costumed interpreters including cowboys, lawmen and lovely Victorian ladies can be seen at the Pioneer Living History Village.

title: PIP Coffee + Clay
meta_description: Bringing together art and caffeine in one unique space, PIP Coffee + Clay is a hands-on ceramics and pottery studio offering coffee, tea, and light bites along with wheel throwing and pottery workshops for all skill levels. This spot is the perfect place for a date or group get togethers where you can sip, create, and connect all in one place.

title: Pirate's Fish and Chips
meta_description: Locally owned and operated, Pirate's Fish and Chips has been serving hand breaded fish, shrimp and onion rings since 1982.

title: Pita Jungle at Anderson Springs
meta_description: Waterfront Dining! Celebrating the art of eating healthy with great Mediterranean eats. Full of local artwork and featuring live music on Thursdays for Pita Jungle's Jazz Jam. This cozy restaurant offers great ambiance.

title: Pita Jungle at The Steelyard
meta_description: Located in south Chandler is Pita Jungle, an Arizona-based restaurant known for its health conscious focused menu that features healthy dishes from fresh ingredients. Dishes highlight Mediterranean, Lebanese and Middle Eastern cuisines as well as a robust selection of vegetarian and vegan dishes.

title: Pitta Souvli
meta_description: Pitta Souvli is a family-owned, casual Mediterranean grill featuring fresh and healthy foods. The atmosphere is warm and cozy, including the shaded outdoor patio, which feels like a private garden with its misters.

title: Pizza Twist
meta_description: This west Chandler restaurant serves traditional, Chicago-style and the twist - they are well known for their Asian-inspired pizzas featuring a number of Indian variations for crafting a 'truly authentic Indian' pizza. Indian toppings included desi meat (hamburger with spices), paneer (a fresh cheese) and naan (flatbread) pizzas. Diners may also opt for more traditional toppings including a number of vegetarian and vegan options or other items from the menu including calzones, samosas, wings (Buffalo, tandoori and tikka masala) and end their meal with tiramisu or Ras malai, a cheesecake-like Indian dessert.

title: Planet Sub
meta_description: Fresh-baked, from scratch bread is the basis for these deluxe deli sandwiches featuring high quality deli meats, cheese, and fresh produce.

title: Playtopia! at Tumbleweed Park
meta_description: Playtopia! at Tumbleweed Park is one of Chandler’s most imaginative and beloved playground destinations, offering a whimsical world of themed play spaces designed to spark creativity and endless fun. Set within the expansive Tumbleweed Park, this 2.5‑acre playground invites kids to climb, slide, explore, and let their imaginations run wild. Playtopia! features three distinct themed zones—Farm Land, City Land, and Critter Land—each filled with custom play structures, towers, bridges, swings, and slides that encourage discovery at every turn. Children can pretend they’re tending to a farm, navigating a bustling town, or exploring the natural world, all within a beautifully shaded, family‑friendly setting. Parents appreciate the park’s thoughtful design, including ample shade canopies, picnic areas, and nearby restrooms, making it easy to settle in for an afternoon of play. The surrounding Tumbleweed Park adds even more to enjoy, with open green space, walking paths, sports fields, and plenty of room to roam. Whether you’re planning a family outing, meeting friends for a playdate, or exploring Chandler with little ones, Playtopia! delivers a joyful, adventure‑filled experience that keeps families coming back again and again. Open for public use from 6 a.m. to 10:30 p.m.

title: Pokitrition - Sushi Burritos & Poke
meta_description: Pokitrition - Sushi Burritos & Poke features custom poke bowls and offers a more modern twist with its sushi burritos filled with your choice of ahi tuna, salmon and cooked shrimp.

title: Pop Pot & Tea
meta_description: This California-based chain features Taiwanese hot pot and tea and is cooking up something fun for everyone! Enjoy 20+ hot pots, rice bowls, and a variety of small plates-- all with a little flare. While you're there, check out their menu of delicious classic teas, milk teas, cream teas, fruit teas, and slushes. You can find them in the Lee Lee International Supermarket Plaza.

title: Portillo's
meta_description: Enjoy a selection of Chicago-style hot dogs, Italian beef sandwiches, char-grilled burgers, salads, and homemade Chocolate cake at Portillo's in West Chandler. The casual restaurant features a large dining room, drive-through, and outdoor seating.

title: Potato Corner
meta_description: Often coined as home of the "World's Best Flavored French Fries" since 1992. What originally started as a small food cart in the Philippines as you'll find Potato Corner at Chandler Fashion Center mall. Serving a large variety of french fries and seasonings. Opt for Original, Loopy (curly) fries, Sweet Potato fries, Jo Jo chips or Tator Tots and pick a seasoning - BBQ, Cheddar, Sour Cream & Onion, Chili BBQ, Cinnamon & Sugar or Garlic & Parmesan for the full experience. You'll also find chicken, baked potatoes and cold beverages at the food stand. The eatery also runs a vegetarian fryer for those seeking a completely vegetarian snack.

title: Precious Elements Jewelry & Coin
meta_description: Established in 2016, this family-owned boutique jewelry store is one of Arizona's largest dealers in turquoise jewelry. The south Chandler store also offers a large selection of fine jewelry, high-end watches, loose stones, coins and bullion. And for collectors, shoppers will often find a great variety of vintage coins and Native American jewelry to supplement their collections.

title: Press Coffee Roasters
meta_description: Specializing in high quality coffee that has been roasted in small batches, Press Coffee has been named Phoenix's best roasted for two years running. Press Coffee features a variety of espresso beverages, drip coffee, tea and assorted hot and cold food items. Every Saturday at 10 a.m., Press Coffee offers one-hour coffee tasting sessions that take you on a trip around the world as you explore four distinctly different coffees and a history on each and how the beans became the flavor you taste today. The Coffee Tastings require registration for $10 and after completing the class, participants receive a $10 gift card to use at Press Coffee.

title: Priceless Too
meta_description: Priceless Too is a local bar that has been serving its patrons for more than 30 years. Featuring a selection of cocktails, beer on tap, assorted bar games and televisions for watching sports games. The neighborhood bar also offers a reverse happy hour.

title: Prime, A Shula’s Steak House
meta_description: Prime, A Shula's Steak House offers a modern take on the traditional American steak house at this rooftop lounge and restaurant offering exceptional views.

title: Puro Cigar Bar
meta_description: Puro Cigar Bar is a local late-night hot spot for catching a game on one of 20+ televisions or take in the sunset view from the balcony while enjoying a cigar from their extensive collection, their vast array of whiskey or try out a local craft beer.

title: QuartHaus
meta_description: Tucked away in Downtown Chandler, QuartHaus is more of a beer-garden inspired wine bar offering a selection of 25 craft beers, including a few of their own brews, and eight wines on tap. The facility features roll-up garage-style doors that open to a courtyard featuring a grassy area for lawn games including cornhole and a basketball court perfect for a fun and casual evening.

title: Queen Creek Olive Mill
meta_description: Located in the heart of Queen Creek, the Queen Creek Olive Mill is Arizona’s only fully operational olive farm and mill, delivering a genuine tree-to-table experience inspired by Arizona’s agricultural heritage. This family-run, 100-acre property features more than 9,000 olive trees and produces premium, estate-crafted extra virgin olive oil right on site. Guests are invited to stroll through the groves, discover the journey from harvest to pressing, and sample a variety of freshly milled olive oils and rich balsamic vinegars in the on-site marketplace. Beyond tastings, visitors will find artisan foods, unique gifts, and locally sourced specialties that showcase the flavors of Arizona. With guided tours, special events throughout the year, inviting dining options, and charming retail spaces, the Queen Creek Olive Mill offers an immersive taste of authentic Arizona farm life. The Queen Creek Olive Mill is a 40- to 45-minute drive from most hotels in Chandler.

title: Queen's Bowl Chinese Food
meta_description: Good quality Chinese foods at a reasonable price.

title: Quiches & Pies
meta_description: Enjoy a slice of Paris at this artisanal French bakery and coffee shop in Uptown Chandler. Launched by famed Chef Fabrice Buschtetz and his wife Maidread, this cozy and welcoming cafe features handcrafted quiches, pies, and locally roasted coffee. The cafe brings a taste of France using French butter, chocolate, and more in its abundant selection of freshly prepared pastries.

title: Radford Racing School
meta_description: Radford Racing School, the Official High Performance Driving School of Dodge//SRT, is a premier performance driving and racing training center offering world-class experiences for individuals and groups. The school offers more than 80 performance vehicles, sedans, SUVs, Ligier JS F4 single seaters, and gas-powered go karts. Radford Racing School includes state-of-the-art facilities and event space for private parties and corporate meetings.

title: Rainbow Donuts and Smoothies
meta_description: Rainbow Donuts and Smoothies is a cozy, family-owned restaurant serving a large variety of freshly made donuts, breakfast sandwiches and beverages. Locals know the restaurant more for their large selection of cronuts (croissant donuts) including their famed red velvet cream, nutella cream, taro and their beloved maple bacon cronut.

title: Rainbow Ryders
meta_description: Rainbow Ryders Hot Air Balloon Company has been creating unforgettable experiences in the sky for over 40 years. Take in Arizona’s stunning landscapes from a whole new perspective with sunrise flights offered daily, weather permitting, or enjoy the beauty of a desert sunset during select winter evening rides. Drift peacefully above the Sonoran Desert, soaking in panoramic views as you float effortlessly through the sky. After your flight, celebrate your adventure with a traditional toast and light refreshments. Whether it’s your first flight or a long-awaited bucket list moment, Rainbow Ryders invites you to rise above it all and experience the magic of hot air ballooning.

title: Raising Cane's Chicken Fingers
meta_description: Raising Cane's Chicken Fingers keeps it simple and good with their focus on crunchy, fried chicken fingers, crinkle-cut french fries and buttery Texas toast.

title: RaphaTea
meta_description: At Rapha Tea Boba Tea House, you'll find traditional Vietnamese coffee, regular tea, milk tea, the Rapha Tea "Butterfly Series" and more! They're currently serving fresh pastries, including muffins, cookies, bread and cinnamon rolls.

title: RareTea
meta_description: RareTea offers a wide variety of teas brewed in-house including milk tea, matcha, fruit tea and smoothies. RareTea's mission is to introduce high-quality, innovative tea beverages through unique brewing technologies. title: S'edav Va'aki Museum
meta_description: Formerly the Pueblo Grande Museum, the S'edav Va'aki Museum is located at a 1,500 year-old Hohokam village ruin in modern day Phoenix. For over 70 years the museum has been dedicated to the study and interpretation of the Hohokam culture. On the 102 acre park grounds, visitors explore the ruin of an 800 year-old platform mound possibly used by the Hohokam for ceremonies or as an administrative center. An excavated ballcourt, and to full-scale reproductions of prehistoric Hohokam homes can be viewed along the ruin trail. The site also includes some of the last remaining intact Hohokam irrigation canals.
