Our full-service kitchen freshly prepares and caters breakfast, lunch, dinner as well as mid-day snacks.

title: South Mountain Park and Preserve
meta_description: At more than 16,000 acres South Mountain Park and Preserve is America's largest municipal park and is actually collection of three mountain ranges, the Ma Ha Tauk, Gila and Guadalupe. With more than 51 miles of primary trails for hiking, mountain bike riding and horseback riding the park is suitable for all ability levels. From the park's main entrance, visitors may drive up the Summit Road 5.5 miles to Dobbins Lookout and enjoy grand views of the valley or continue on to the Gila Lookout for a view of the Gila River Valley. A special note: The scenic roads are shared by bikers and hikers alike and there are numerous steep sections and blind curves. Please drive with caution and obey all traffic signs. Trail head hours are from 5 a.m. - 7 p.m.

title: SoZo Coffeehouse
meta_description: Located in north Chandler, SoZo Cffeehouse is a local favorite featuring a casual, laid-back vibe. Visitors will enjoy the local art that adorns their walls- available for purchase along with several couches dotting their lounge, ideal for relaxing and enjoying some time with friends. In addition to donating money from every purchase to a local or international cause, the coffee shop offers a large variety of traditional hand-crafted, espresso drinks including enticing flavors like the Cinnamon Toast Crunch latte as well as a weekly drink special. Looking for a fun, relaxing evening - enjoy an evening of live, local music, every Friday and Saturday from 7-10 p.m. and be sure to check their event calendar for open-mic nights held on their stage.

title: Spin the Bottle
meta_description: Find a fantastic selection of wines from all over the world and local Arizona craft beers at this Downtown Chandler bottle shop. Experience a shopping experience like no other by attending a tasting or other unique event and discover a world full of libations you have yet to explore.

title: Spitz Mediterranean Street Food
meta_description: Experience a modern and fresh take on Mediterranean, Greek and American-style street eats. Enjoy the Chandler-centric street art while you dine on overflowing wraps, gyros, salads and bowls, wings and fries served alongside a great selection of craft beer. The restaurant offers a variety of vegetarian, vegan, keto, gluten-free, and paleo options to meet various dietary needs.

title: Spooky’s Swirls
meta_description: From props to pastries, this gluten-free bakery will have you screaming for more. Celebrating horror/sci-fi fandom, the bakery offers memorabilia from horror and science fiction movies along with fresh baked, gluten-free treats including brownies, cupcakes, cheesecake and more.

title: Springfield Golf Resort
meta_description: Springfield Golf Resort is an 18-hole, executive facility in Chandler, Arizona. Hailed by locals as the “best-kept golf secret in Chandler”, the club prides itself on a fun, welcoming atmosphere, friendly staff, and beautiful course conditions. With four sets of tees to select from, the course is easy enough for a beginning golfer to enjoy their day while also being able to provide a challenge for even the most seasoned player. An average pace of play for 18 holes at Springfield is three hours, too, ensuring your day on the course will be a relaxing and enjoyable experience from start to finish. Be sure to stick around after the round to enjoy a delicious meal or a craft cocktail at Grill 61. With live music and entertainment several times a week, this is the perfect spot to end your day at Springfield Golf Resort.

title: SpringHill Suites by Marriott Phoenix Chandler/Fashion Center
meta_description: Located in the East Valley, the newly renovated SpringHill Suites Chandler Fashion Center by Marriott places you in the heart of Chandler. Our spacious hotel suites across the street from Chandler Fashion Center provide a sleek modern backdrop for your stay with separate space for dining, sleeping and relaxing in a refreshing new color palette. Keep hunger at bay with our complimentary hot breakfast every morning. Guest Room Amenities: 101 spacious guest suites with 2 Queen or 1 King size beds and pull-out sofa sleeper Kitchenette including mini-fridge, microwave and sink Comfortable sitting area Individual climate control

title: St. Amand Kitchen & Cocktails
meta_description: St. Amand Kitchen & Cocktails is a chef-driven, cocktail-themed restaurant located in the heart of Ocotillo, Chandler, AZ. With a vibrant, contemporary atmosphere indoors and an expansive, climate-controlled patio outdoors, it’s the ideal setting to sip, dine, and unwind. Guests can enjoy an elevated fine casual dining experience featuring dinner, Sunday brunch, and a happy hour menu. Live music performances take place Friday through Sunday, and private dining is available in “The Vault” for special events.

title: Stadium Club
meta_description: Watch the game and grab a bite to eat at this family-owned sports pub, Stadium Club. Guests will find a lively atmosphere featuring lots of TV's to catch a game on, billiards, video games, and American grub,

title: State Forty Eight
meta_description: Arizona's most iconic apparel has its roots firmly planted in Chandler and provides clothing, hats, stickers and more. Started by three friends sharing their passion for Arizona, State Forty Eight is constantly evolving, offering exceptional designs that celebrate the best of the state with uniquely designed shirts, hats and accessories inspired by Arizona. Their clothing items and hats are readily available at select shops and restaurants with a dedicated retail store located in Uptown Chandler. The brand also offers one-stop services for companies featuring collaborative designs, screen printing, embroidery and art & branding services

title: Staybridge Suites Phoenix- Chandler
meta_description: The beautiful, all-suite Staybridge Suites Phoenix Chandler is located just west of the Chandler Fashion Center in the heart of West Chandler. This all-suite hotel is located near Intel, Microchip, Tokyo Electron, Wells Fargo, Bank of America, Honeywell and PayPal. This property is a short drive from Downtown Chandler, ASU Research Park, the Tempe campus of Arizona State University, Wild Horse Pass Resort and Casino, Lone Butte Casino and South Mountain Park, the largest municipal park in the US. This beautiful hotel boasts a complimentary full hot breakfast buffet each morning, an evening social including a light meal every Tuesday, Wednesday and Thursday evenings, a complimentary laundry facility, storage lockers, 24-hour fitness center, a business center and complimentary high-speed Internet access. Every one- and two-bedroom suite is designed with separate living and sleeping areas and a fully equipped kitchen. Other amenities include a pool and whirlpool, a fire pit and patio grills. The warm hospitality you’ll experience visiting this fine hotel will complete your travel experience to the Valley of the Sun.

title: Staybridge Suites Phoenix- Chandler
meta_description: Number of Sleeping Rooms/Suites: 104 Number of Meeting Rooms: 1 Total Meeting Space: 750 sq. ft. Type of Meeting Venue: Classroom Distance to Phoenix Sky Harbor International Airport: 16 miles Distance to Mesa Gateway Airport: 17 miles The beautiful Staybridge Suites Phoenix Chandler is centrally located providing easy access to major highways/interstates making the short commute to Downtown Phoenix, The Phoenix Sky Harbor International Airport, Scottsdale, Tempe, Mesa and Gilbert even shorter! Not driving? No need to worry! The Staybridge Suites is walking distance from Chandler Fashion Center where you can shop to your heart’s desire and find several food options to cure your cravings.

title: Stinger's Golf Club
meta_description: Practice your putting or hit a round of golf at this indoor golf club in Chandler. This indoor facility features 6 golfing bays with simulators for any type of play. There is also a full service bar and dining menu to enjoy while you stay cool indoors.

title: Stone & Vine Urban Italian
meta_description: Located in south Chandler, Stone + Vine serves authentic, family recipes and provides an inviting ambiance that is perfect for dinner with family and friends. Chandler's Stone + Vine features wood-burning pizzas, traditional Italian dishes including house specialties: spaghetti and meatballs, eggplant parmigiana and ravioli. The restaurant also offers a full bar, cocktails, selection of beers and a variety of wines available by the glass or bottle. Open daily at 11 a.m. with a daily happy hour from 3-7 p.m.

title: Streets of New York
meta_description: Italian entrees, sandwiches, pizza by the slice or whole are all served here in this family friendly restaurant.

title: Strut Bridal Salon
meta_description: Say "yes" to the dress at this beautiful boutique bridal salon located in Chandler. Whether you are looking for a wedding, bridesmaid, prom or quinceañera dress, Strut Bridal has so many options. Book an appointment with a stylist for the ultimate experience.

title: Sumits Yoga Chandler
meta_description: An established yoga studio since 2009 with class options for all ages. Discover the wide variety of classes ranging from vin, hot yoga, yoga nidra and more.

title: Sunbird Golf Club
meta_description: The semi-public, Gary Panks-designed course has challenging features for every level of golf enthusiast. Novice recreationalists to the more serious low handicappers will enjoy the 4,384-yard, par-66 course at Sunbird Golf Club. Located in retirement row near Sun Lakes, AZ, this course is a favorite for those who love a challenging, yet scenic course.

title: Sunny's Breakfast & Lunch
meta_description: Located on the northwest corner of Alma School Rd. & Chandler Blvd. Sunny's Diner is a locally operated breakfast and lunch concept. For breakfast, the restaurant serves traditional breakfast fare including pancakes, breakfast skillets, waffles and more while lunch options include hamburgers, pitas, gyros, salads and sandwiches. Outdoor dining is a breeze with Sunny's generous front patio.

title: Super Shuttle Express
meta_description: With Super Shuttle Express, It’s all about simplicity. Super Shuttle Express offers transportation to and from Phoenix Sky Harbor (PHX) International Airport and your hotel. All reservations must be booked in advance and may be booked online at www.supershuttle.com.

title: Superstition Mountain Lost Dutchman Museum
meta_description: The Superstition Mountain Museum collects, preserves and displays the artifacts, history and folklore of the Superstition Mountains, Apache Junction and the surrounding region. Perhaps nowhere in the entire United States is there an area full of legend, history and intrigue as the rugged 160,000 acre Superstition Mountain range in Central Arizona.

title: Supreme Shawarma
meta_description: Supreme Shawarma offers a variety of Mediterranean dishes such as beef kabab sandwiches, chicken shawarma plates, and a gyro supreme plate.

title: Sweeties Candy of Arizona
meta_description: Looking for a tasty treat from the good old days? Housing over 75,000 pounds of candy and over 4,000 different types from more than 170 manufacturers, visitors of all ages will enjoy the newly expanded sweet shop for a trip down memory lane or to discover a new favorite at Arizona's largest and most comprehensive candy store and soda shoppe. Not only does Sweeties Candy of Arizona house the largest PEZ selection in the western half of America, but also offers more than 700 mix and match bulk candies and 80 sugar free items. Sweeties Candy of Arizona also offers 300+, pure cane sugar, glass bottled sodas for your drinking enjoyment. Whether you are looking for a classic drink like Bubble Up or are adventurous enough to try a Peanut Butter and Jelly Soda you'll have a great time exploring all the varieties!

title: Swingin' Safari Mini Golf
meta_description: Swingin’ Safari Mini Golf will offer the ultimate, glow-in the-dark indoor mini-golf adventure for the whole family.

title: Symphony Hall Phoenix
meta_description: Since the doors to Symphony Hall first opened in 1972, millions of people have crossed the venue's welcoming threshold into a cultural and performance icon integral to the Valley's arts landscape. The multi-purpose Symphony Hall, home to The Phoenix Symphony, Arizona Opera and Ballet Arizona is also the site for Broadway touring companies, a variety of dance productions, and appearances by popular entertainers, as well as the location for business seminars and convention general sessions.

title: T-Swirl Crepe
meta_description: T-Swirl Crepe is a Japanese dessert shop located near 99 Ranch Market, serving up a vibrant selection of Japanese-style crepes. Choose from a sweet or savory filling served fresh inside a thin, crispy shell with gluten-free options available.

title: Tacos Chiwas
meta_description: Led by a husband and wife team, diners will discover what many taco aficionados claim to be the best tacos in the Valley. Select from a nine varieties of street-style tacos served on handmade corn tortillas including asada, pollo, lengua, pastor, barbacoa and a vegetarian option the calabacitas featuring Mexican squash, corn, onion and cheese. The Tacos Chiwas menu also includes a selection of gorditas, quesadillas and burritos and from 10 a.m. - Noon, breakfast burritos are available daily. Tacos Chiwas restaurant owners, Armando Hernandez and Nadia Holguin are semifinalists for the 2024 James Beard Awards for Outstanding Restaurateur.

title: Tacos N More
meta_description: Located in south Chandler, Tacos N More features a full range of freshly prepared Tex-Mex dishes, from breakfast burritos to red chile and chile rellenos.

title: Taliesin West
meta_description: In late 1937, Wright purchased land in northeast Scottsdale, where he and his apprentices took on the task of building Taliesin West as a winter “camp.” The complex of buildings included residential spaces, theaters, gift shop and an architectural studio and drafting room. Visitors to Taliesin West will not see a museum, but rather a remarkably vital and active community of students and architects working together to maintain Wright’s vision.

title: Tandoori Pizza
meta_description: Grand Opening on May 15, 2026! Tandoori Pizza brings a bold fusion to the table by blending classic Indian flavors with a comfort food favorite, pizza. From fresh, unique pizza offerings to pasta, wings, and vegetarian options layered with aromatic spices, this pizza spot delivers a one-of-a-kind twist. It's a must-try experience for those looking to spice up pizza night in Chandler.

title: Tao Garden
meta_description: Featuring a variety of Chinese entrees including pork, beef, chicken, seafood, and vegetarian dishes.

title: Tap N Taco
meta_description: Mexican Street Food in Downtown Chandler Bring on the bold flavors at this local Downtown Chandler restaurant, serving up authentic Mexican street food in a vibrant atmosphere. Dig into $2 street-style tacos with fresh tortillas made daily and pair with agua fresca, coke, a refreshing cocktail or cold beer at the full-service bar. Delicious Mexican Favorites Include: Street tacos Quesadillas Nachos Churros Come hungry and enjoy these favorites along with so much more! Monday & Tuesday Speciality Try the birria on a variety of menu items, exclusively available to order on Mondays and Tuesdays each week.

title: Taqueria Factory
meta_description: This family owned business has over 25 years of experience bringing Mexican Cravings to the US and has two locations in Chandler. With its satisfying mixture of flavors and vibrant spices, Taqueria Factory, is sure to get your taste buds excited. The menu features burritos, nachos and quesadillas, and it also offers sides, drinks and a variety of salsas and dips with a variety of hand-crafted margaritas and agua frescas. This Uptown Chandler location is adjacent to their sibling restaurant, Frutilandia - a must stop dessert shop when in Chandler.

title: Taqueria Factory
meta_description: This family owned business has over 25 years of experience bringing Mexican Cravings to the US and has two locations in Chandler. With its satisfying mixture of flavors and vibrant spices, Taqueria Factory, is sure to get your taste buds excited. Their menu offers quesabirrias, tacos, micheladas and more! The south Chandler location features a walk-up counter for ordering, an outdoor dining patio and an indoor bar. The menu features burritos, nachos and quesadillas, and it also offers sides, drinks and a variety of salsas and dips with a variety of hand-crafted margaritas and agua frescas.

title: Taqueria Mi Casita
meta_description: Traditional Mexican food at an affordable price.

title: Taroko Sports
meta_description: Open daily, this vibrant sports entertainment hub is designed for everyone, featuring high-tech batting cages that provide real-time performance analytics and interactive scoring, making practice fun for all skill levels. But that's just the beginning! Guests can also enjoy mini bowling, electronic darts, 5D racing simulators, arcade games, and various basketball challenges. Plus, savor delicious comfort food like wings, soft pretzels, chicken tenders, and pizzas, available around the clock. Taroko Sports is devoted to creating a lively, family-friendly atmosphere where sports enthusiasts of all ages can play, eat, and enjoy live games on big-screen TVs anytime. We can't wait to welcome you!

title: Tattered Aprons Baking Co.
meta_description: Small batch, scratch bakery operating in conjunction with American Way Market and Highland Yard Vintage Market in Uptown Chandler. Specializing in fresh baked cookies, scones, brownies and pastries available for sale individually or by the box.

title: Tea Fresho
meta_description: Enjoy freshly brewed teas, Vietnamese coffee and assorted handcrafted beverages including Mango Coconut Crushes, Creamy Egg Coffees, Fresh Fruit teas and more at this Vietnamese-inspired tea and coffee shop in west Chandler.

title: Tea Snow Boba & Coffee
meta_description: Enjoy hand-crafted boba drinks, Vietnamese coffee, classic milk teas & fruity blends, shaved snow, smoothies and assorted treats at this West Chandler cafe.

title: TeaMakers & Company
meta_description: TeaMakers & Company is a specialty tea brand dedicated to offering high-quality, ethically sourced teas from around the world. The company carefully selects whole-leaf teas and handcrafted blends to deliver rich flavor and authentic character in every cup. Their collection typically includes a variety of black, green, oolong, herbal, and specialty teas to suit different tastes and occasions.

title: Tempe History Museum
meta_description: Tempe History Museum is a place where the community comes together to explore Tempe’s past, share its present and imagine its future. On display in our main gallery is information, photographs and artifacts focused on four themes: Surviving in the Desert, Building Our Community, College Town and Living Together. There is also a dedicated space for children to do hands-on activities in the gallery. Each year the museum produces a featured exhibit based on a topic of local interest and we have regular rotating exhibits in our Community Room Gallery. Visit the museum Tuesday – Saturday, 10 a.m. – 5 p.m. Sunday, 1 – 5 p.m. Admission is always free. The museum’s regular hours are extended for evening programs and events such as Performances at the Museum and Third Thursday programs. Check our website [www.tempe.gov/museum] for program information. Tempe History Museum is located at 809 E. Southern Ave., next to the Tempe Public Library.

title: Tempe Town Lake
meta_description: Take a journey to Tempe Town Lake, one of Arizona's most popular outdoor destinations. More than 2 million people visit Town Lake each year for assorted water activities, attend concerts, fireworks and a variety of festivals. There is a 5.7 mile, loop walking path that offers a fast and virtually flat, paved path for biking, walking and running.

title: Teriyaki Madness
meta_description: Find fresh ingredients and made-to-order teriyaki bowls crafted with house-made sauces at this fast casual eatery.

title: Terror Trader
meta_description: When horror isn't just a season - but a lifestyle, make Terror Trader a must-do stop on your trip through Arizona. This is not your average Halloween pop-up; it's a destination that showcases Arizona's thriving local horror scene. Discover handmade items from local artists, featuring a diverse range of offerings that include horror movie props, jewelry, and unique collectibles for a one-of-a-kind souvenir. You'll find treasures here you can't get anywhere else. And throughout the store, you'll capture iconic photo-ops with life-sized monsters and unique horror-themed set pieces at the massive store.

title: Thai Chili 2go
meta_description: Thai Chili 2go’s Chandler location is your destination for authentic fast-casual Thai cuisine. Whether you dine in, order delivery, or choose catering services, you’ll experience fresh ingredients and authentic flavors every time.

title: Thai Rama
meta_description: Thai Rama is a family-owned and operated restaurant serving authentic Thai curries, noodle dishes, soups and appetizers. Enjoy weekday lunch specials from 11 a.m. - 3 p.m. and dinner service from 5-9 p.m. For added convenience, to go orders may be picked up through their own drive thru lane, but be sure to call your order in first!

title: The Aloha
meta_description: With a nod to mid-century architecture and a classic roadside motel, enjoy a cool, fresh vibe at this new boutique extended stay property located north of Downtown Chandler. The Aloha Hotel features a swimming pool and is a full ground-up remodel of a 1950s-style roadside motel, including the guest rooms, pool, and common areas.

title: The Ashley Castle
meta_description: Rent your castle for the day in Chandler, AZ at The Ashley Castle, a premiere wedding and social event venue located just south of Loop 101 and the 202 SanTan interchange. The special event facility features a number of services ranging from basic venue rental to all-inclusive planning - including decorating, catering, flowers and decorations.

title: The Back Nine Golf
meta_description: The Back Nine Golf is bringing the golf experience to Chandler no matter the season. Golf year-round any time of the day at this indoor golf experience. Enjoy high quality golf simulators for a little driving and putting practice. This amazing indoor golfing experience offers both public tee times and memberships for golfers of all skill levels.

title: The Broken Yolk Café
meta_description: Breakfast, brunch and lunch are on the menu at The Broken Yolk Café. From traditional breakfast classics to those with a southwestern flair, the restaurant's extensive menu and ample portions are big on flavor. Breakfast is served all day, including more than 20 freshly prepared omelets while lunch dishes include tacos plates, salads and hamburgers.

title: The Casual Pint Craft Beer Market
meta_description: While the Casual Pint Craft Beer Market is not a traditional brewery - it is more like a coffee shop for craft beer aficionados. Sit down to a pint and grab a quick bite, fill a growler, or purchase a few cans or bottles to create your own six pack - the Casual Pint Craft and Beer Market is a great place for fans of craft beer.

title: The Cheesecake Factory
meta_description: Located at Chandler Fashion Center, The Cheesecake Factory is well known for its vast menu featuring more than 250 menu items and more than 50 signatures cheesecakes and desserts. From sandwiches to salads to pastas to steaks to comfort food favorites and so much more, The Cheesecake Factory is an excellent choice for a casual, yet upscale dining experience.

title: The Crowned Egg
meta_description: The family owned and operated eatery is a neighborhood hotspot for breakfast and lunch. The casual restaurant features traditional breakfast and lunch fare from pancakes to sandwiches to burgers, salads and more.

title: The Driver Provider
meta_description: The Driver Provider is a full service transportation company offering a range of services from an extensive fleet of vans, mini-buses and motor coaches.

title: The Gallery at CCA
meta_description: The Gallery at CCA is located inside the Chandler Center for the Arts, and hosts exhibitions for visitors that feature regional and national artists. Exhibitions rotate out on a regular basis throughout the year. Visitors will discover a varied palette of original artworks from oil and acrylic canvasses, to ceramic works, sculpture, jewelry, photography, mixed media and textiles. The Gallery is also home to one of two of the only Art-O-Mat machines in Arizona; for $5 cash, visitors can choose a piece of art dispensed from a refurbished cigarette machine, featuring art by artists from across the country. The Gallery at CCA is one of two nonprofit galleries in Downtown Chandler, supported by the Chandler Cultural Foundation.

title: The Great Greek Mediterranean Grill
meta_description: A casual restaurant that serves authentic Greek food.

title: The Greek's Grill
meta_description: Fresh, authentic, Mediterranean cuisine serving up offerings from gyros, shawarma, and more.

title: The Hungry Monk
meta_description: Family friendly restaurant featuring a variety of tasty entrees and boasting an extensive collection of craft beer and Arizona brews.

title: The Keg Steakhouse + Bar
meta_description: Quality, comfort and value are three key ingredients that make the Keg experience unlike any other. When it comes to steak, The Keg serves only the finest cuts, aged for tenderness and seasoned with a unique blend. Classic cocktails, delicious appetizers, succulent seafood, and an outstanding wine list round out its classic menu. The Keg's friendly and knowledgeable staff creates an atmosphere that encourages guests to enjoy, relax and be themselves. Whether you're getting together with friends or celebrating with family, you'll always be welcomed with a smile. You don't need an excuse or an occasion to come to The Keg. Whether you join us for after-work drinks or a spontaneous date night, we'll always make you feel celebrated.

title: The Mexicano
meta_description: The Mexicano by Chef Joey Concepts serves up a lively and authentic dining experience. The chef-driven menu features traditional Mexican flavors along with a blend of fusion cuisine including birra bao buns and a guacamole and salsa Ferris wheel. Stop by for happy hour any day of the week with extra special deals on Taco Tuesdays and Margarita Mondays, or try out the famous build-your-own margarita bar. Enjoy your meal in the vibrant atmosphere both inside and outside on the patio with live entertainment daily.

title: The Milkshake Factory
meta_description: Opening in May 2025! The Milkshake Factory is a premium dessert shop specializing in handcrafted milkshakes, gourmet European-style chocolates, and specialty sundaes. The South Chandler restaurant offers a wide range of classic and creative flavors with housemade ice cream, sauces, and more. With a rich history rooted in a family-owned chocolate business, The Milkshake Factory blends tradition with innovation to create indulgent sweet treats for all ages.

title: The NOW Massage Chandler
meta_description: Located on Chandler Blvd in front of the Chandler Fashion Center, The NOW Massage Chandler offers next-level massages to help you recharge your energy and spirit. Choose from three Swedish-inspired massages and a wide variety of enhancements that can be added to tailor your experience. Book an appointment NOW for those moments you need a relaxing escape from the bustle of everyday life, or make massages part of your monthly ritual with a membership.

title: The Olive Branch Boutique
meta_description: The Olive Branch Boutique in Chandler is the perfect spot to pick up a souvenir or meaningful gift for anyone on your list. This charming shop features a hand-selected collection of artisan goods, jewelry, candles, home decor, and some unique finds. Be sure to also check out their event calendar and reserve a spot to try their tea room experience.

title: The Original Pancake House
meta_description: At The Original Pancake House in south Chandler, mornings are built serving classic breakfast favorites made with care from the freshest ingredients. Everything from the old-fashion sourdough starter for pancakes to the maple syrup, is made from scratch daily. This breakfast spot has been using the same award-winning recipes since 1953, and can't wait to share their delicious food with you!

title: The Ostrich
meta_description: Located in Downtown Chandler, directly under Crust Chandler, the Ostrich is a neighborhood craft cocktail lounge inspired by the rich history dating back to the city’s founding days of 1912. Once a watering hole for the nation’s traveling elite, the space has been remodeled and re-imagined into a trendy drinking destination housed in the forgotten basement tunnels running to the Crowne Plaza San Marcos golf course clubhouse and the old railroad station. Today- classic cocktails, historical furniture and timeless service come together to create a unique, craft cocktail destination that harkens back to yesteryear. As you would expect, cocktails are serious business and the Ostrich offers a great selection of traditional and inventive cocktail creations.

title: The Parlay Kitchen + Cocktails
meta_description: Located in the Price Corridor, this gastropub features a selection handcrafted eats and sips with a diverse selection of craft cocktails, beer and wine.

title: The Peach Cobbler Factory
meta_description: This dessert spot is known for its warm, Southern-style cobblers each topped with vanilla ice cream with lots of flavors to choose from including the classic peach cobbler. Make sure when you stop by this South Chandler location to check out their other dessert offerings like banana pudding, cinnamon rolls, cookies, shakes, brownies, and so much more.

title: The Perch Brewery
meta_description: Enjoy a unique dining experience at this fashionable yet inviting craft brewery located in Downtown Chandler. In addition to its upscale pub fare, locals celebrate The PERCH for its lush, exotic bird-filled garden and expansive rooftop bar – offering unique views of Downtown Chandler.

title: The Phoenix Zoo
meta_description: The Phoenix Zoo opened in 1962 and has grown to 125 acres of land, 2.5 miles of walking trails and 1,200 animals. The Phoenix Zoo is Arizona’s largest collection of mammals, fish, invertebrates, birds and reptiles and one of the most successful zoos in the United States. A great place for groups and individuals alike, many picnic tables and rentable armadas help complete your zoo experience.

title: The Screamery
meta_description: The Screamery blends handcrafted, classic ice cream with modern flavors. The ice cream is pasteurized on-site at their locally owned facility and the ice cream is made with grass-fed milk and natural ingredients featuring no artificial chemicals. From scoops to shakes or Screamery creations including ice cream nachos or a flight of ice cream featuring six sample cups for the undecided - the Screamery is a sweet spot not to be missed.

title: The Shoppes at Casa Paloma
meta_description: The Shoppes at Casa Paloma is located in West Chandler, near I-10 and is home to locally owned boutiques and hosts a variety of destination dining and eateries. The Shoppes at Casa Paloma is also home to an array of engaging, unique events and art shows.

title: The Sicilian Baker
meta_description: Choose your size, choose your shell and choose your cream at The Sicilian Baker Cannoli Bar & Market. This unique, Italian café features an amazing, create-your-own cannoli bar with a variety of shell options, sizes and a dozen creams for your perfect cannoli. Indulge your sweet tooth with Italian cookies, pastries, gelato and espresso bar. More than a spot for a sweet treat, the café offers a selection of grab and go items including ready made Muffuletta sandwiches and Italian market pantry staples and freshly made items including homemade pasta, meat cutlets, arancini and more to create your own Italian meal at home or in your hotel room.

title: The Sicilian Butcher
meta_description: The Sicilian Butcher specializes in hand-rolled meatballs, fresh-made pastas and hand-crafted sauces and house-cured meats and a customizable cannoli bar which allows you to craft your own Italian dessert with more than a dozen fillings. The restaurant is located near Chandler Fashion Center mall and features a generously sized patio for outdoor dining.

title: The Sleepy Whale

title: Veterans Memorial: Field of Honor
meta_description: The Field of Honor at Veterans Oasis Park is a powerful and visually striking memorial that honors the Southeast Valley’s past, present, and future veterans, offering visitors a meaningful place for reflection, remembrance, and learning. A Signature Veterans Memorial in Chandler Located on the southwest corner of Veterans Oasis Park, the Field of Honor is the first memorial of its size and scope in the Southeast Valley. It pays tribute to veterans from all branches of the U.S. military, highlighting their service through a thoughtfully designed space that blends symbolism, artistry, and American history. A Symbolic, Immersive Design The memorial features upper and lower levels, each rich with symbolism: Lower Level – The American Flag in Stone This area mirrors the exact ratio of the American flag, with stone plinths arranged to represent stars and stripes. Their varying heights emulate a flag rippling in the wind, while their formation symbolizes soldiers marching in unison. Some plinths disappear below ground—21 in total—representing a twenty‑one‑gun salute for those who did not return home. Upper Level – The Arizona Star Overlook An elevated plaza overlooks the memorial, featuring a star-shaped design inspired by the Arizona State Flag and the service flag displayed by families with loved ones in active service. From here, visitors can reflect as they look over the symbolic “soldiers” below. Honoring Local Veterans The Field of Honor includes a Veterans Recognition Wall, where names, ranks, and service branches of local veterans are displayed. Eligible honorees must have lived in the Southeast Valley and been honorably discharged. Nominations remain open as long as space is available. A Peaceful Setting for Reflection Set within the natural landscape of Veterans Oasis Park, the memorial’s recessed design creates a quiet, contemplative environment. Visitors of all ages can explore the space, learn about American history, and pay tribute to those who served. Chandler holds an annual Veterans Day celebration at the Veterans Oasis Park Field of Honor. Open from 6 a.m. to 10:30 p.m.

title: Veterans Oasis Park and Chandler Nature Center

With its tranquil lake, miles of trails, and the engaging Chandler Nature Center, this east Chandler gem invites visitors to slow down, explore, and connect with the natural world. A Desert Sanctuary for Outdoor Lovers The park’s landscape blends Sonoran Desert vegetation, wetland habitats, and wide open green space, creating a peaceful setting for walking, birdwatching, photography, and picnicking. More than 4.5 miles of trails wind through the park, offering easy routes for families, runners, and nature enthusiasts. The 5-acre Community Fishing Lake adds another layer of relaxation, with opportunities to cast a line and enjoy the calm surroundings. Chandler Nature Center: Hands-On Discovery Located at the park’s entrance, the Chandler Nature Center serves as a hub for environmental education and exploration. Visitors can enjoy: • Interactive exhibits highlighting local wildlife and ecosystems • Nature-themed programs and workshops for all ages • Guided hikes, stargazing events, and seasonal activities • A gift shop with nature books, educational materials, and souvenirs It’s a welcoming stop for families, curious kids, and anyone looking to learn more about the Sonoran Desert environment. Scenic, Serene, and Full of Wildlife Veterans Oasis Park is a favorite among birders, with dozens of species spotted throughout the year. The park’s mix of wetlands and desert terrain attracts everything from herons and hawks to hummingbirds and migratory waterfowl. Sunrise and sunset offer especially beautiful views across the lake and along the surrounding trails. A Must Visit for Nature-Minded Travelers Whether you’re exploring Chandler with your family, seeking a peaceful morning walk, or looking for a place to immerse yourself in Arizona’s natural beauty, Veterans Oasis Park offers a refreshing blend of recreation and discovery. The Chandler Nature Center enhances the experience with immersive, hands-on learning opportunities, making it a place that encourages visitors to return.

The Xeriscape Garden is a functional, user-friendly demonstration space with mature trees, shrubs and plants found in the "Landscape Plants of the Desert Southwest" booklet available from the Water Conservation office. There is a granite path that flows between areas of the garden where themes include a children/pet friendly area, a wildlife garden and a low maintenance garden. Changes in grading help to reduce erosion and also highlight passive water harvesting techniques through the installation of berms and swales. Large signage explains design and landscaping techniques and smaller signs on many of the plants identify them by Latin and common name. New sculpture art in the park was created through a partnership with the Chandler Arts Commission and Chandler Unified School District’s Art Masterpiece program. Artist Juanita Hull-Carlson worked with 5th and 6th grade students from Erie Elementary School to create the artworks on display.
